summary: Depth contracts for roadmap organisms whose representative previews are strong enough to guide organism-level verification work without promoting organism IDs or native pivot/calculator features to supported public capabilities.

acceptance_criteria: score rows can be summarized by student with deterministic totals
completion/status inputs are constrained by list validation
native pivot-style score distribution is explicitly excluded from supported claims
explicit_non_claims: does not create native Excel pivot tables
does not infer or grow arbitrary gradebook matrices
does not calculate grading policy semantics beyond provided numeric rows
classes.promotion_gate: Promote only after an organism verifier checks score summary, allowed status values, protected formulas, and matrix growth semantics in one fixture.

acceptance_criteria: completion rows can be summarized by person or requirement with deterministic totals
summary output can be materialized into a printable report region
matrix analytics remain separate from supported native pivot behavior
explicit_non_claims: does not auto-expand person-by-requirement matrices
does not prove cross-training coverage optimization
does not create native pivot tables
classes.promotion_gate: Promote only after a matrix fixture verifies added people or requirements, completion summaries, and printable reporting together.

acceptance_criteria: new ticket rows can be appended to the queue table
SLA or age threshold exceptions are highlighted deterministically
dashboard/pivot summaries are excluded until separately verified
explicit_non_claims: does not implement workflow automation or assignment routing
does not create queue dashboards
does not enforce SLA policy beyond explicit threshold highlighting
classes.promotion_gate: Promote only after a queue fixture verifies append, status validation, SLA highlighting, open-ticket summary, and protected summary cells.

acceptance_criteria: deal rows can be summarized by stage with deterministic totals
risk or probability threshold exceptions can be highlighted
forecast dashboards remain outside supported native pivot claims
explicit_non_claims: does not forecast revenue beyond provided rows
does not create native pivot dashboards
does not infer CRM stage semantics
classes.promotion_gate: Promote only after a pipeline fixture verifies stage validation, forecast summary, risk highlighting, and protected forecast formulas together.

acceptance_criteria: new maintenance issue rows can be appended
overdue or risk threshold exceptions are highlighted
risk/action register semantics remain bounded by explicit columns
explicit_non_claims: does not schedule maintenance work
does not infer root-cause or risk policy semantics
does not automate action closure
classes.promotion_gate: Promote only after a maintenance fixture verifies append, status validation, overdue/risk summary, and protected action totals.

acceptance_criteria: action rows can be summarized by status with deterministic totals
summary output can be materialized into a printable review report
closure-evidence semantics remain outside supported atom claims
explicit_non_claims: does not provide legal or compliance advice
does not verify closure evidence quality
does not create native pivot dashboards
classes.promotion_gate: Promote only after a compliance fixture verifies action status validation, due-date threshold flags, closure summaries, and printable report output.

acceptance_criteria: risk or score threshold exceptions are highlighted deterministically
register rows can be materialized into a printable safety report
score dashboards remain separate from supported native pivot behavior
explicit_non_claims: does not provide safety or compliance advice
does not infer risk scoring policy
does not create native pivot dashboards
classes.promotion_gate: Promote only after a safety fixture verifies status validation, score thresholds, completion summaries, protected formulas, and printable reporting.

acceptance_criteria: repeated payment-row formulas can be extended without formula drift
calculated interest, principal, and balance cells are protected
financial advice and amortization correctness claims are explicitly excluded
explicit_non_claims: does not provide financial advice
does not prove amortization correctness
does not verify payoff termination or cumulative balance policy
classes.promotion_gate: Promote only after a calculation schedule verifier checks balance recurrence, payoff termination policy, protected formulas, and input/editable ranges in one fixture.
